k:容.mnemonic: A hole (穴) dug into the side of a valley (谷): a cave big enough to hold everything you own. Contain (form, appearance, looks).

k:直.mnemonic: An eye (目) squints along a carpenter's square with ten (十) marked at the top, lining the plank up against the corner until there is no bend left. Straight (fix, honest, direct).

k:等.mnemonic: At the temple (寺) the bamboo (竹) is cut into lengths that match exactly, one for each monk, none longer than another. Equal (etc., class, and so on).

k:両.mnemonic: A hood (冂) dropped over a mountain (山) covers its left slope and its right slope at once, the two sides under a single lid. Both (two, old coin).

k:美.mnemonic: A big (大) sheep (羊), fat and with a splendid fleece: to a shepherd nothing in the world looks finer. Beauty (beautiful).

k:変.mnemonic: A caterpillar goes under the lid (亠), and what comes out to trudge (夂) away is not what went in. It looks odd, different. Change (strange, unusual, odd).

k:様.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) beside a tree (木) lowers its head and sips water (水) so politely that you would call it Mr. Sheep. Such graceful ways. Manner (way, situation).

k:件.mnemonic: The cow (牛) has wandered into the neighbour's field again, and the leader (亻) has to be called out to deal with this matter. Affair (case, item, matter).
k:件.hint: The business of the stray cow.

k:反.mnemonic: The overhang (厂) leans one way, and the stubborn hand beneath it also (又) pushes, but the opposite way. Against everything. Anti-.
k:反.hint: A hand pushing back at the rock.

k:伝.mnemonic: A leader (亻) hands on a cocoon (厶): the secret of silk, passed carefully from one generation to the following one like a legend. Transmit (convey, legend, go along).

k:得.mnemonic: Take a stroll (彳) at dawn (旦) before anyone else is up, and take the measurement (寸) of each shell on the beach: the early walker pockets the best. Acquire (gain, profit, obtain).
k:得.hint: First on the beach at sunrise.

k:任.mnemonic: The king (王) rides away and leaves his kingdom with a leader (亻) and a samurai (士): you two, it is in your hands now. Entrust (responsibility, duty, term).
k:任.hint: The king leaves it with them.

k:流.mnemonic: A cocoon (厶) drops into the river (川), and a tsunami (氵) of water carries it off downstream, bobbing along with the current. Flow (current, style).

k:置.mnemonic: A net (罒) is laid out straight (直) on the ground and left there: set the trap down and walk away. Put (place, set, placement).
k:置.hint: A net laid down and left.

k:井.mnemonic: Four beams crossed in a square frame, seen from above, round the mouth of a shaft where the bucket goes down. Well (well crib, town, community).

k:演.mnemonic: Under a roof (宀), actors play out the story of the tsunami (氵) that swept over the rice field (田), while the village watches. Perform (act, performance, play).
k:演.hint: Acting out the flood on stage.

k:試.mnemonic: Before the ceremony (式) you must say (言) your lines aloud to the priest, to see whether you really know them. Test (try, experiment, attempt).
k:試.hint: Reciting the lines for the priest.

k:転.mnemonic: A car (車) wheel runs over a cocoon (厶). It sticks to the tyre and goes round and round with it. Revolve (turn around, change, alter).
k:転.hint: A cocoon stuck to a wheel.

k:楽.mnemonic: A white (白) drum on a stand made from a tree (木), with icicles (冫) on each side tinkling like bells: music to lie back and enjoy. Comfort (music, fun, ease).

k:食.mnemonic: A lid lifted above a bowl piled with steaming rice on its little stand: the meal is served. Eat (food).
k:食.hint: A lid lifted off a bowl.

k:光.mnemonic: A sparkle (⺌) running on legs (儿): light that leaps from the torch and races outward in a line. Ray (light, bright, brightness).

k:保.mnemonic: A leader (亻) guards the tree (木) and lets no mouth (口) take a bite of its fruit, so that some is kept for winter. Preserve (protect, maintain, keep).

k:足.mnemonic: A kneecap, the round box at the top, with the shin and foot striding out underneath. Leg (foot, be sufficient).

k:局.mnemonic: Under a flag (尸), in a bent little cubicle, a mouth (口) speaks through a hatch: who is waiting, please? The office counter. Bureau (board, office, affair).
k:局.hint: A voice from the office hatch.

k:支.mnemonic: A hand holding up a cross-shaped prop under a heavy bough, keeping it from falling. Support (branch, sustain).
k:支.hint: A hand propping up a bough.

k:府.mnemonic: Under a big canopy (广), rows of clerks attach (付) stamps and tags to every paper that comes in. Government office (urban prefecture, borough).
k:府.hint: Clerks stamping under a big roof.

k:示.mnemonic: A small altar table: a flat top, one leg, and offerings laid out on either side for the gods to see. Show (indicate, point out, express).

k:際.mnemonic: At the edge of the mound (阝) a tent (癶) is pitched to put on a show (示). That only happens for a special event. Occasion (edge, verge, side).
k:際.hint: A show tent on the hill's edge.

k:再.mnemonic: The king (王) pulls a hood (冂) over himself and sneaks out, the top of his crown still poking through. He did the same yesterday. Again (twice, second time, repeat).
k:再.hint: The hooded king sneaks out once more.
